Home.description: Connecting sectors to foster economic, tourism and cultural development in the region.
Home.visionText: To be a cluster recognized nationally and internationally for linking different sectors to implement strategies that foster the economic, tourism and cultural development of the region with quality, warmth, inclusive and sustainable services.
Home.missionText: To improve the quality of life of our inhabitants, strengthen cultural and natural identity, and position Chignahuapan and Zacatlán as tourism destinations of excellence.
Home.actionsText: Strategies for linking productive, tourism and academic sectors for regional development.
Home.odsText: Aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals for an inclusive and sustainable future.
